## 🚀 Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## 💡 Motivation
Please explain why this feature would be useful:

- What problem does this solve?
- How would this improve the user experience?
- Are there any existing workarounds?

## 📋 Detailed Proposal
Describe the feature in detail:

- **User Interface**: How should it look and feel?
- **User Flow**: How would users interact with it?
- **Technical Implementation**: Any technical considerations?

## 🎯 Acceptance Criteria
What would make this feature complete?

- [ ] Criterion 1
- [ ] Criterion 2
- [ ] Criterion 3

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 📱 Platform Support
Which platforms should this feature support?

- [ ] iOS
- [ ] Android
- [ ] Web (PWA)
- [ ] All platforms

## 🔧 Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, or examples about the feature request.

## 📊 Priority
How important is this feature to you?

- [ ] High - Critical for my workflow
- [ ] Medium - Nice to have
- [ ] Low - Minor improvement

## 🤝 Willing to Contribute
- [ ] I'd be willing to help implement this feature
- [ ] I can provide design mockups
- [ ] I can help with testing
- [ ] I can help with documentation
